home.title: Echo | Where communities come to life
home.description: Echo is an open source (GNU AGPL v3) community platform for connection, conversation, and collaboration. Voice, chat, and privacy-minded design—try Echo in your browser or download the app.
home.heroLede: Echo is a modern community platform built for connection, conversation, and collaboration.

privacy.title: We don't ask for your ID
privacy.body: Join freely and stay anonymous. No ID verification, ever.

share.title: Share your screen
share.body: Show, explain, and collaborate in real time.

voice.title: Voice chats that connect
voice.body: Crystal-clear voice chats built for real conversations.

faqs.question: What is Echo?
faqs.answer: Echo is an open source, privacy-focused communication platform with real-time chat, voice, and community features.

faqs.question: Is Echo a Discord alternative?
faqs.answer: Yes. Echo is built for people who want a modern Discord alternative for communities, group chat, and voice conversations.

faqs.question: Where can I try Echo?
faqs.answer: Open Echo in your browser or download the app from the Download page.

faqs.question: Who is Echo for?
faqs.answer: Echo is for communities, friend groups, and teams who want voice, text, and media in one focused place.

faqs.question: Is Echo open source?
faqs.answer: Yes. Echo is released under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL). You can read the source, self-host, and contribute on GitHub at https://github.com/ad3lre/echo.
